watches.name: Sher Easy Read clock for home and schools
watches.description: * Schools ordering 5 or more clocks receive a significant discount. Please see details below. Easy Read Clock for Primary Schools, Secondary Schools & Homes The SHER Easy Read Clock has been designed to make telling the time simpler and more intuitive for children and teenagers, while still looking like a modern, everyday wall clock. Rather than being a teaching aid that is brought out for a lesson and then put away, the Easy Read Clock is designed to become the permanent clock in the classroom . It simply sits on the wall and does its job, but every time a pupil looks up to check the time, they are also reinforcing their understanding of how an analogue clock works. Suitable for primary schools, secondary schools and the home , its carefully considered layout makes analogue time easier to understand without looking childish or out of place in an older classroom. Learning through everyday use The idea behind the Easy Read Clock is simple: children learn by doing. Every time they want to know the time, they look at the same clock. The easier-to-read layout helps them work it out independently, and that process is repeated naturally throughout the day. The hours are offset and segmented , clearly showing where each hour starts and ends. This makes it easier to identify which hour the hour hand is actually pointing towards. Around the outside of the dial is a full 60-minute track , allowing the minute hand to point directly towards the number of minutes past the hour. Put simply, you can look at the number each hand is pointing towards and read the time. For example, when the minute hand points towards 40, the clock shows 40 directly, rather than requiring a child to remember that the number 8 on a traditional clock represents 40 minutes. With daily repetition, those hand positions gradually become familiar. Children begin to understand what they represent and, over time, become less reliant on the additional markings. The aim isn't to create a different way of telling the time. It is to help children build the confidence and familiarity they need to read any traditional analogue clock or watch . A permanent classroom clock, not a temporary teaching tool Many educational clocks are designed specifically for younger children and can feel out of place once pupils move beyond the early stages of learning to tell the time. The SHER Easy Read Clock takes a different approach. Its additional information is incorporated into a clean, modern clock face, making it appropriate as the everyday wall clock in a classroom rather than something that feels like a separate learning resource. That means the same clock can be used throughout a child's education, from primary school into secondary school. This is particularly valuable for older pupils who understand the principle of analogue time but still have to stop and think when reading a traditional clock. Having an Easy Read Clock permanently visible provides repeated practice without requiring a formal lesson. Every glance at the clock becomes a small opportunity to learn. Designed for primary and secondary schools Learning to tell the time is often associated with younger children, but confidently reading an analogue clock remains relevant well beyond primary school. Young people increasingly see the time on phones, computers and other digital displays, meaning they may have fewer opportunities to practise reading analogue time during everyday life. Placing Easy Read Clocks throughout a school creates those opportunities naturally. Rather than replacing analogue clocks with digital displays, pupils continue to see and use analogue time every day, but in a format that makes the relationship between the hands and the numbers easier to understand. Clear enough to learn from. Designed to stay on the wall. watches.name: Sher Kids Watch
watches.description: The Sher Kids Watch is a grown up looking watch for kids that is specifically designed to make telling the time easier. The hour markers are offset and segmented to make it super clear where the hour starts and ends and the full minute track makes it super easy to know the minutes at a glance! Housed in a 32mm stainless steel case, its proportions are perfect for kids ages 5 and up. Adults with smaller wrists can wear it too! The watch comes with both a coloured and a white strap. *New personalised extras just added:* We offer 2 additional extras you can add to your order: 1) Add a personalised engraving to the caseback 2) Add an 'if lost' phone number to the straps. This will be a handy addition to help a child if ever they unfortunately get lost Watch Specifications: 32mm diameter 316L Stainless steel case 100m water resistance Quick release strap system (both straps included) 9mm thickness 16mm lug width 37.5mm lug to lug Sapphire anti scratch crystal Full lume dial 2 x Soft silicone straps (coloured and white strap) Screw down crown for water resistance Japanese Quartz Miyota 2035 movement 2 Years battery life (batteries can be replaced by removing the caseback) FAQ I am not based in the UK, can I still buy the watch? Yes, we ship globally. A price in your local currency will be shown on this page. Please also note, all orders are shipped from the United Kingdom , for any orders outside of the UK, EU, USA and Canada, any customs duties, taxes, or import fees are the responsibility of the customer and are not included in the checkout price . These charges are typically collected by the courier before delivery. Where is it made? The watch movement is made in Japan, the case, crystal, dial and strap are made in China and the final watch assembly and quality checks are done in the UK When can I expect delivery of this order? Orders will be dispatched within 48 hours of your order . We would expect most orders to arrive within 7-10 days of dispatch depending on where you are based. What colours are available? We have just launched 2 new colours, so now have a grey neutral option plus the new blue and pink colour way. All watches also come with a white strap. Limited production numbers Only a limited amount of watches will be made for this run, so if you would like to order one, please make the most of the current stock we have as we are expecting to sell out based on the demand we have seen so far. More will be produced in the future but delivery dates for those will later in the year. watches.name: Sher X TWP Ltd Edition Dive Watch
watches.description: Designed in partnership with That Watch Podcast , this limited-edition Sher dive watch blends functional tool-watch capability with refined everyday versatility. This collaboration celebrates shared passion, storytelling, and meticulous design. At its heart is a striking textured fumé blue dial , transitioning from black at the edges to deep blue toward the centre . The subtle surface texture adds depth and richness, giving the watch a dynamic character that shifts beautifully in changing light. As a true dive watch, it features a durable matte ceramic timing bezel with lumed numerals , robust 316L steel construction, and excellent legibility in all conditions. The engraved and embossed limited-edition numbered caseback reinforces its collectible status, while the Miyota 9039 automatic movement ensures reliable daily performance. Please note this is limited to 300 numbered pieces and once sold, thats it, no more will be produced. Global shipping is currently free for all orders. Each of the 300 pieces is individually numbered and delivered in an exclusive limited-edition travel case.
